hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A deflationary hook that charges 1.2% on every buy (ETH collected into a burn pot) and 1.2% on every sell (tokens burned directly), executing buyback-and-burn swaps every 20 user swaps. Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to a one-time operation, blocks sells in the same block as a buyback, and includes a deployer-controlled allowlist that can prevent non-allowlisted addresses from selling.
